review.why: Writes data and ML resumes that separate offline evaluation, experiments and production results.
review.summary: Resume writing for analysts, analytics and data engineers, data scientists and ML engineers. A role table says what evidence to prioritize, and rules keep claims honest: metric with baseline, experiment versus correlation, pipeline volume with time basis, forecast versus realized savings.
strengths: Role-by-role evidence table for the five data job families
Rules that stop common overclaims (AUC as business lift, backfill as throughput)
Worked example that refuses to invent a churn reduction
cautions: Instructions only: no template or keyword list
Defers job matching to another skill (resume-tailor)
Needs the user to supply evaluation details to be useful
